test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, SICK is coded as 168 and TAR is coded as 117. How will NOMAD be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca29526384a7031f8cd8d688a2b81878e724832e958c03a9a8f48f7506157507.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of alphabet positional value × Number of letters of word.**

SICK is coded as 168

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53461b554275ffa9f376043fd5bfb3596134aa7704fc1467a3c40a638a2ff8a0.png] 

Number of letters in word SICK = 4

= (19 + 9 + 3 + 11) × 4

= 42 × 4

= 168

and

TAR is coded as 117.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32ddbe8de0e0c60fa4b302c49690f3461e89fa9141dfc450a7e4f96550a40133.png] 

Number of letters in word TAR = 3

= (20 + 1 + 18) × 3

= 39 × 3

= 117

Similarly,

NOMAD will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27a024402b5061e9a0b4cdf2a53f903a44bf52c29dfd3160bf22af1e532cd0e9.png] 

Number of letters in word NOMAD = 5

= (14 + 15 + 13 + 1 + 4) × 5

= 47 × 5

**= 235**

Hence, the correct answer is **"235".**
